'''Victor "The Shade" Rist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of [[House Rist]], a group of elite [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and nobles of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he was residing within [[House Rist (estate)|House Rist estate]] when an individual affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] infiltrated the building and tried to access the data on a security console. Victor Rist attacked the intruder, but was defeated and [[Death/Legends|killed]].
